text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-l-o-c-k-e-d a n-i-g-h-t-s r-a-d-i-o s-i-g-n-a-l t-o d-e-v-i-a-t-e a d-r-o-n-e, l-e-f-t a g-p-s j-a-m-m-e-r a-t t-h-e d-e-p-l-o-y-m-e-n-t s-i-t-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y s-i-g-n-a-l i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t.
2) t-h-e y a-c-t-o-r f-a-k-e-d a n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n e-r-r-o r-e-p-o-r-t t-o d-e-c-e-i-v-e t-h-e l-o-g-g-i-n-g s-y-s-t-e-m, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-e-d a s-p-o-o-f-i-n-g d-e-v-i-c-e a-t t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t p-o-i-n-t, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-i-a-g-n-o-s-t-i-c t-o o-b-s-c-u-r-e t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-m-i-t-a-t-e-d a s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d g-p-s g-l-i-t-c-h t-o t-r-i-g-g-e-r a-n a-u-t-o-m-a-t-i-c l-a-n-d-i-n-g s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e, l-e-f-t a s-o-f-t-w-a-r-e i-m-a-g-e a-t t-h-e r-e-c-e-p-t-i-o-n z-o-n-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g a-u-d-i-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d t-h-e d-r-o-n-e-s r-o-u-t-e t-o t-a-r-g-e-t t-h-e c-o-l-l-e-c-t-i-o-n s-p-o-t, l-e-f-t a t-e-m-p-o-r-a-r-y a-n-t-e-n-n-a a-t t-h-e s-t-a-g-i-n-g a-r-e-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d c-o-n-f-i-g-u-r-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d t-h-e d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y p-a-r-c-e-l-s a-t t-h-e a-l-t-e-r-n-a-t-e l-a-n-d-i-n-g z-o-n-e, d-i-s-p-o-s-e-d o-f t-h-e i-m-p-l-a-n-t-e-d a-p-p-a-r-a-t-u-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e p-r-e-s-e-r-v-a-t-i-o-n.
